err.playlist: This is a playlist or a channel: paste the link of one video.
err.live: A live stream or a premiere that has not started cannot be downloaded - try after it ends.
err.geo_blocked: The site does not show this video in your country: use a proxy of a country where it is available.
err.age_restricted: The video is age-restricted: cookies.txt of a browser signed in to an adult account is needed.
err.login_required: The site wants a signed-in user: cookies.txt of a browser signed in to the site is needed.
err.private: The video is private: only an account it is shared with sees it - its cookies.txt is needed.
err.members_only: The video is for the channel's members: cookies.txt of a member's browser is needed.
err.drm: The video is DRM-protected: it cannot be downloaded.
err.unavailable: The video is removed or unavailable: check the link.
err.rate_limited: The site limits requests from this address (429): wait, add cookies.txt or change the proxy.
err.proxy: The proxy does not answer: check it in the network settings.
err.network: The site is not reachable: check the connection or the proxy.
err.cookies_invalid: This is not a Netscape cookies.txt: export it again with a cookies.txt extension.
err.format_unavailable: No format of this quality: choose another.
err.no_audio: The video has no sound track: choose a quality with video.
err.outdated: This yt-dlp cannot read the site any more: update it and try again.
err.disk_space: Not enough disk space for the video.
err.running: The download is still running: cancel it first.
err.update_failed: The new yt-dlp did not pass its check - the previous one stays.
